alexscaves:game_controller.text: They are the only source of the exclusive pottery sherds and the Game Controller.

alexscaves:abyssal_altar.text: They are made of Abyssmarine, and are different compared to other structures in the Abyssal Chasms, due to the fact that it is the only structure to include an Abyssal Altar on top.

alexscaves:serene_salad.text: They can be fed Serene Salad and ridden for a brief amount of time, during which they are capable of leveling the terrain with a hefty stomp.

alexscaves:amber_monolith.text: Amber Monolith Pillars (referred to as alexscaves:amber_monolith in-game) are the natural spawning of Dinosaurs in the Primordial Caves.

alexscaves:block_of_chocolate.text: Inside the biome, the terrain consists primarily of Blocks of Chocolate, Frosted Block of Chocolate, and Cake Layers, which make the biome…

alexscaves:purple_soda_bucket.text: A Bucket of Blue Sweetish Fish is a Blue Sweetish Fish inside a Bucket of Purple Soda.

alexscaves:purple_soda.text: A Bucket of Green Sweetish Fish is a Green Sweetish Fish inside a Bucket of Purple Soda.

alexscaves:disc_fragment_fusion.text: A Fusion Disc Fragment is a variant of disc fragment used to craft the Fusion Music Disc.

alexscaves:music_disc_fusion.text: A Fusion Disc Fragment is a variant of disc fragment used to craft the Fusion Music Disc.

alexscaves:music_disc_tasty.text: The Fusion Music Disc is another variant of music disc that is crafted from its matching disc fragments similarly to Music Disc 5.

alexscaves:cloak_of_darkness.text: Darkness Incarnate is a status effect granted by the Hood & Cloak of Darkness that allows the player to fly similarly to creative flight, albeit much faster.

alexscaves:spelunkery_table.text: Once you have found a Spelunkery Table and some Cave Tablets, you can begin the process of researching the strange inscriptions on the tablet.

alexscaves:cooked_lanternfish.text: Lanternfish is a food item and brewing ingredient that can be eaten or cooked in a furnace, smoker, or campfire to make Cooked Lanternfish.

alexscaves:sea_pig.text: A Sea Pig is an unsating food item that can be eaten by the player, at high risk of inflicting Hunger.

alexscaves:candy_cane.text: They quickly burrow through blocks, and can be mounted by launching dual-wielded Candy Cane Hooks towards them.

alexscaves:cooked_tripodfish.text: Tripodfish is a food item that can be eaten or cooked in a furnace, smoker, or campfire to make Cooked Tripodfish.

alexscaves:conversion_crucible.text: They are the only place where the Conversion Crucible generates naturally.

alexscaves:primordial_helmet.text: The Primordial Armor Set consists of the Primordial Helmet, Primordial Tunic, and Primordial Pants. Unlike all other armor sets, this set does not include boots.

alexscaves:primordial_tunic.text: The Primordial Armor Set consists of the Primordial Helmet, Primordial Tunic, and Primordial Pants. Unlike all other armor sets, this set does not include boots.

alexscaves:primordial_pants.text: The Primordial Armor Set consists of the Primordial Helmet, Primordial Tunic, and Primordial Pants. Unlike all other armor sets, this set does not include boots.

alexscaves:cooked_radgill.text: Radgill is a hazardous food item that can be eaten or cooked in a furnace, smoker, or campfire to make Cooked Radgill.

alexscaves:disc_fragment_tasty.text: A Tasty Disc Fragment is a variant of disc fragment used to craft the Tasty Music Disc.

create:mechanical_mixer.text: Brass is an alloy obtained by mixing and Zinc together with a Mechanical Mixer, Basin, and Blaze Burner. It is used primarily for crafting item sorting machines.

create:blaze_burner.text: Brass is an alloy obtained by mixing and Zinc together with a Mechanical Mixer, Basin, and Blaze Burner. It is used primarily for crafting item sorting machines.

create:andesite_alloy.text: For example, a Shaft requires you to have first made Andesite Alloy. The table below categorizes the Create items into levels corresponding to the order in which items must be built.

create:precision_mechanism.text: Lets say you want to make a Precision Mechanism. First you have to use a deployer to apply a cog on a gold sheet then apply a large cog then an iron nugget.

create:electron_tube.text: The Brass Hand, the Electron Tube, the Precision Mechanism, the Propeller, and the Whisk are all items which function solely as ingredients in crafting recipes for advanced mechanical components.

create:brass_hand.text: The Brass Hand, the Electron Tube, the Precision Mechanism, the Propeller, and the Whisk are all items which function solely as ingredients in crafting recipes for advanced mechanical components.

create:zinc_ore.text: Crushed Brass is a crushed version of the material, Brass, and was primarily obtainable via heated mixing of Crushed Copper Ore and Crushed Zinc Ore.

create:creative_motor.text: Chorus Chrome was a crafting ingredient that was used to craft the Creative Motor (previously known as the Motor) and was also used to upgrade the Handheld Blockzapper.

create:goggles.text: Among its many functions, it is used as a crafting ingredient for Wrenches and Engineer's Goggles and is used in .

create:andesite_funnel.text: The Funnel's functionality would later be revised in version 0.3 and would be given to the Andesite Funnel and the Brass Funnel.

create:brass_funnel.text: The Funnel's functionality would later be revised in version 0.3 and would be given to the Andesite Funnel and the Brass Funnel.

create:brass_casing.text: Active Belt pulling Extractors can pull items from belts reinforced with Brass Casing. When the extractor is blocked, the belt will stall.

create:rotation_speed_controller.text: The Integrated Circuit was an item used to craft the Rotation Speed Controller. It was removed in the Create 0.3.2 update.

create:netherite_backtank.text: When used with a full Netherite Backtank and , the wearer is immune to and .

create:track_station.text: It has a red flag much like the Train Station that is automatically raised when the Postbox has anything in its inventory.

create:controls.text: Precision mechanisms allow you to build Rotation Speed Controllers, Train Controls, and other advanced devices.

create:contraption_controls.text: Sliding doors can also be prevented from opening by onboard Contraption Controls filtered for them.

create:mechanical_bearing.text: It is composed of a Windmill Bearing (or Mechanical Bearing in pre 0.3 versions) and at least 8 sails or sail-like blocks.

create:water_wheel.text: Due to the easy access to its components, the windmill along with the Water Wheel are the earliest automatic power generators in the game.

create:hand_crank.text: The Valve Handle functions much like the Hand Crank, though the amount and direction it rotates with one can be adjusted in its Value Settings Screen.

create:track.text: To start off, you're going to need some Train Track. Place this down in a line.

enderscape:end_stone_rubble_shield.text: When blocking with a Rubble Shield, moving and jumping triggers a dash in the direction you’re moving. Dashing gives you a significant horizontal speed boost, at the cost of 3 durability.

enderscape:rubble_chitin.text: Rubblemites drop 5 experience points, 0-1 of their shell material, and have a 25% chance to drop Rubble Chitin.

burnt:extinguisher.text: After a short delay, the barrel will explode with blast damage and trigger the burn to surrounding blocks Craft or find the Fire Extinguisher to put out fires.

create_potioneering:mixed_potion_block.text: Pump vanilla potion fluids through Create tanks, pipes, spouts, basins, mixers, and item drains to combine their effects into one Mixed Potion fluid.

kaleidoscope_tavern:molotov.text: Features 🍷 Complete multi stage brewing system with 7 quality levels 🍾 10+ types of drinks including Wine, Champagne, Whiskey, Vodka and more 🌿 Grape farming with wild grapevines, trellises, and a pressing tub 🪑 16 color sofas and bar stools (sit able) 🏠 Rich tavern decorations: bar counter, bar cabinet, string lights, paintings and more 📋 Writable chalkboard and sandwich board with text alignment options 🔥 Throwable Molotov Cocktail Images…

kaleidoscope_tavern:pressing_tub.text: Crush your harvest in the Pressing Tub , then fill a Barrel with juice and ingredients to start fermentation. Your brew's quality evolves over time through 7 levels : Level Quality 1 Undrinkable 2 Inferior 3 Common 4 Fine 5 Crafted 6 Exquisite 7 Vintage Once ready, attach a Tap to your barrel and extract the finished drink into a bottle.

fightsfrights:mimentis_claw.text: Mime Blocks / Reinforced Mimentis Claw — Mimentis claws can craft invisible Mime Blocks, as well as the Reinforced Mimentis Claw — a reusable, fully enchantable pickaxe version of the Mimentis Claw.

fightsfrights:deadsteel_scimitar.text: Can be given to Piglins, Illagers, and the undead by right clicking them with it. _Boss Items _ Ominous Gem — Shoots the General's projectiles; can be used to upgrade to the Deadsteel Scimitar, which applies Poison.

fightsfrights:peeping_hivestone.text: Peeping Hivestone — Found in the new "Hive" Nether biome; watchful creepy crawlies lie within. Can be mined without Silk Touch for random ore or bug rewards.

fightsfrights:redstone_display.text: Redstone Display — A 7 segment display showing the power of the strongest redstone line connected to it. Circuit Lever — Outputs different redstone strengths depending on player input (shift to decrease).

fightsfrights:ominous_essence.text: Ominous Essence — A concentrated version of the Ominous Bottle. Curses nearby mobs when drunk, or is used to craft Ominous Plating.

fightsfrights:banshaas_lungs.text: Banshaa's Lungs — The mind controlling scream can be consumed by the player or brewed into Maddening, Gazing, or Aversion potions.

fightsfrights:ominous_scepter.text: Ominous Scepter — Shoots projectiles when not fully charged. Charging it longer summons helpful "Effigies" that attack monsters.

fightsfrights:terrantula_leg.text: Offering them a Terrantula Leg or Gill may convince them to abandon their home and scatter. Grimmsquito: Disgusting warm biome farers.

fightsfrights:ominous_bottle.text: Ominous Bottle — Backported from later versions; can be crafted, or spat out along with milk, honey, or a Golden Tongue while under Bad Omen.

fightsfrights:charged_chili.text: Charged Flesh — Can be eaten for a speed boost at the cost of health, or crafted into Charged Chili for a bigger speed boost plus fire resistance.

fightsfrights:monster_salad.text: Monster Salad — A "delicious" monster meal combining every effect of its ingredients at once. Monstrous Plate — A copper alloy used to craft a variety of things, most notably an armor set that turns you into the monster.

fightsfrights:rotten_handle.text: Rotten Handle — Mostly a crafting ingredient, but can be eaten if you really hate yourself. Putrid Scythe — Not massive damage, but inflicts Poison on hit.

fightsfrights:blunt_javelin.text: Blunt Javelin — Made from Jelly. Deals no damage, but its knockback power is undeniable.

fightsfrights:mysteryblock.text: Mystery Block — You already know what this is. Antidote — Cures a viral infection contracted from the undead or raw meat.

fightsfrights:putrid_scythe_2.text: Putrid Scythe — Not massive damage, but inflicts Poison on hit. Also works as an iron hoe.

fightsfrights:golden_tongue.text: Golden Tongue — This air filled tongue can be consumed to levitate like a Scowl, with a curious glowing side effect.

fightsfrights:charged_flesh.text: Charged Flesh — Can be eaten for a speed boost at the cost of health, or crafted into Charged Chili for a bigger speed boost plus fire resistance.

fightsfrights:ravager_horn.text: Ravager Horn — Dropped by Ravagers. Can be played to gain temporary strength.

fightsfrights:ominous_tusk.text: Ominous Tusk — Explodes on use, immobilizing anyone caught in the blast. Also makes Piglins fear the player while it's in their inventory.

fightsfrights:charged_scrap.text: Thunder Core — Can be thrown to strike lightning at a distance, or used to craft Charged Flesh and Ominous Hexes.

fightsfrights:mimic_beetle.text: Mimic Beetle: Mimic Beetles are colonial organisms that inhabit certain ores. These small bugs work together to form a larger, more imposing organism to defend their home.

fightsfrights:pungent_soup.text: Pungent Soup — Made from a bone handle, a Gill, and a bowl — the world's worst tasting food, though your saturation will thank you.

fightsfrights:monster_pop.text: Monster Pop — Crafted from Golden Tongues and Jelly. When consumed, it reveals the location of nearby monsters.

fightsfrights:elder_spine.text: Elder Spine — Dropped by Elder Guardians. Can be brewed into "Guardian's Strength" (Grace + Conduit Power + Strength).

fightsfrights:poison_orb_item.text: Can be given to Piglins, Illagers, and the undead by right clicking them with it. _Boss Items _ Ominous Gem — Shoots the General's projectiles; can be used to upgrade to the Deadsteel Scimitar, which applies Poison.

fightsfrights:empty_hex.text: Empty Hex — An unfilled hex — perhaps it can be filled with something. Blunt Javelin — Made from Jelly.

fightsfrights:bug_dust.text: Mimentis Claw — Used to propel yourself forward or pull mobs closer; also an essential ingredient in Bug Dust.

create_dragons_plus:levitite_fragile_flu.text: Fragile Fluid Tank & Levitite Fragile Fluid Tank : Tank that breaks on impact. (Need Create: Simulated series ) Bulk Coloring & Bulk Freezing supports Create: Granished 's Fan Processing Recipes.

create_dragons_plus:dragon_breath.text: Bulk Ending : Use Dragon Head or Dragon's Breath (Fluid) with Encased Fan to infuse items with energy from The End.

create_dragons_plus:fluid_hatch.text: Quicksand is not a requirement for this feature anymore) Fluid Hatch : Like the Item Hatch, provides convinient take/deposit operation on Fluid Tanks.

createaddition:portable_energy_interface.text: Portable Energy Interface: Transfer energy to and from contraptions. Tesla Coil: Charges electric items, and can also be used to inflict damage to Players and Mobs.

createaddition:creative_energy.text: Creative Generator: Generates a limitless supply of Forge Energy. Connector & Wires: Wires for energy transfer.

createaddition:digital_adapter.text: Digital Adapter: Allows Computercraft computers to talk to various Create blocks (See API). Biomass: Pellet, Fuel.

createaddition:biomass_pellet.text: Biomass, Biomass Pellet, Sead Oil, and Bioethanol. Various wires, rods, spools, and other crafting components.

createaddition:redstone_relay.text: Redstone Relay: Controls energy flow with Redstone. Accumulator: Multiblock energy storage.

createaddition:diamond_grit.text: Diamond Grit Sandpaper. Straw: Applied to a Blaze Burner will give it the ability to burn liquid fuels.

createaddition:rolling_mill.text: To craft these items you need to make a Rolling Mill which is a kinetic machine that is used to make rods and wires.

createaddition:barbed_wire.text: Barbed Wire block. Biomass, Biomass Pellet, Sead Oil, and Bioethanol.

create_enchantment_industry:blaze_forger.text: Blaze Forger : Blaze as an smart anvil. Printer : Copy your written book, enchanted book, name tag, train schedule and more.

create_enchantment_industry:gem_cutter.text: Gem Cutter : Processes gems to their highest quality. Affix Augmentor : Automated affix enhancement.

redomesticate:deed_of_ownership.text: Deed of Ownership The Deed of Ownership is an item purchasable from the Animal Tamer villager. Right clicking on a tamed pet you own binds it to the deed.

redomesticate:sinister_carrot.text: Rabbits only have 3 health by default and usually cannot attack (see: Sinister Carrot). To make them useful, Redomesticate reintroduces another removed feature: rabbits scare off Ravagers .

redomesticate:rotten_apple.text: Rotten Apple & Sinister Carrot Rotten Apples have a chance to form if an apple item despawns on the ground (configurable).

create_integrated_farming:lava_fishing_n.text: Lava Fishing Net : Extends Fishing Net automation to lava when one of Nether Depths Upgrade , Tide , Starcatch and Confluence is installed.

create_integrated_farming:vacuum_harvest.text: We currently offer: Vacuum Harvester : A rotational area harvester that collects and replants mature crops within a range.

irons_jewelry:jewelcrafting_station.text: Requires Iron's Lib, Atlas API, and Curios API About Jewelry Items can be crafted from a pattern at the Jewelcrafting Station block.

simulatedcoasters:coaster_anchorpoint.text: Existing Features Roller Coaster Tracks / Track Anchorpoint Blocks Support for loops, inversions, chain lifts, and jumps Dyable tracks Carts / Cart Linking Rivets that hold sublevels together Balloons as a utility for moving assembled contraptions Planned Features Hydraulic launches Coaster stations More colors for balloons 2 wide cart bogeys !!

advancementframes:advancement_frame.text: The mod adds one item, the Advancement Frame, which can be crafted with an Emerald and some Sticks at any time.

cbc_terminal_ballistics:framed_collapsib.text: Armored copycat: Adds the Copycat Armor Layer and Framed Collapsible Copycat Armor Block. You can freely adjust their toughness with the Armor Upgrader item.

simulated_gauges:altitude_gauge.text: List of New Gauges: Altitude Gauge This gauge can read the height of its block in the world OR the air pressure of its position.

simulated_gauges:velocity_gauge.text: Velocity Gauge This gauge can read the velocity of its block in the world separated into its X, Y, and Z axes.

simulated_gauges:gimbal_gauge.text: Gimbal Gauge This gauge can read the orientation of its block in the world as Euler Angles separated into its X, Y, and Z axes.

universaljewelry:breeze_ingot.text: Current mods this mod adds compatibility for: L_ender's Cataclysm (Crystallized Coral, Cursium, Essence of Storm, Ignitium, Witherite) Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks (Divine Soulshard) Create (Experience Nugget, Rose Quartz) Vanilla (Echo Shard) Also adds 2 unique items: Blood Bone, crafted in an Alchemist Cauldron using Blood and a Bone (requires Iron's Spells) Breeze Ingot, crafted using Breeze Rods and an Iron Ingot

farmerscontracts:contract_board.text: Place a Contract Board , choose an available food order, cook what the customer requested, and turn it in for a reward.

farmerscontracts:contract_box.text: Contract Box Accepted contracts can be delivered without carrying goods to the board in your inventory. Place a Contract Box, fill it with exactly the items the order needs, then seal it with the contract's ticket.

ponderer:miniature_projector.text: Ponder Projectors Two projector blocks : Provides a Miniature Projector and a Life Size Projector , projecting the Ponder scene associated with a source item into the world.

scabbards:weapon_holster.text: Weapon Holster: The weapon holster is a small strap of leather designed to store tools of any size not simply limited to carrying swords!

drivebywiretypewriter:typewriter_hub.text: What it does Adds a Typewriter Hub block. Right click it with an empty hand to start typing — your keypresses are broadcast as redstone signals on the Drive By Wire network, one channel per key.
